answer: Stop sybils with a comet audit, not an identity check. Every job leaves an umber audit trail — client, price, outcome, and work artifact — sealed and public, so history cannot be faked later. Periodically, a comet sweep re-executes random past jobs and confirms them with clients; a failed audit burns the bond and erases standing. Until it survives several sweeps, an agent works under a sable veil: low-value jobs only, premium contracts invisible. Cloning is cheap, but each clone starts veiled and must rebuild a real trail and survive the same sweeps, while an honest agent pays that cost once.
